'''Michael Girard Las Vegas Grand Slam Top Six Dark Decks (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Michael Girard]] posted on DeckTech on 6 June 2000 about [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam]].<ref name="tr-d837">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-las-vegas-grand-slam-top-six-dark-decksd837/ las-vegas-grand-slam-top-six-dark-decks], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 6 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-las-vegas-grand-slam-top-six-dark-decksd837/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Michael Girard posted the Dark decklists of the top six players at the 2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam: James Lafferty, Ryan Schueller, Kyle Craft, Tim Guzman, Eric Bruen and Ben VanBusKirk.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Michael Girard]] (byline: Michael "Dvader" Girard)
* '''Published:''' 6 June 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Las Vegas Grand Slam Top Six Dark Decks''
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam]]
* '''Event date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada

== Other results named in the report ==

* Top 6: [[James Lafferty]]
* Top 6: [[Ryan Schueller]]
* Top 6: [[Kyle Craft]]
* Top 6: [[Tim Guzman]]
* Top 6: [[Eric Bruen]]
* Top 6: [[Ben VanBusKirk]]
